intro: Tapes I keep on repeat while I code, read papers and break things. Press a tape, hit play.

tracks.title: Friends (Intro loop)
tracks.note: That slow, hazy intro stretched to ten minutes. It sits in the background so I can stay inside one problem for hours.

tracks.title: Drugs & Money (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Dark, steady bass with room on top. The instrumental keeps all the mood and none of the words, so it works while I read code.

tracks.title: Slow Down (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Dreamy, half-speed and a little sad. I put it on when I want to stop rushing and think properly.

tracks.title: Blinding Lights (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Pure 80s synth drive with no vocals in the way. The fastest tape on the shelf, good for a last push before a deadline.

tracks.title: High For This (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Cold, spacious and slow-building. Without the vocals the production is what stands out; the whole track is mood.
